about: When each office's contests and terms fall, per state or territory and office kind: term length, stagger, the years and day of the regular election, the primary, the filing deadline and the day the winner takes office. Each field carries SOURCED (with its citation) or ESTIMATED (with its basis and spread); a row is SOURCED only when every field is. 'county-row' covers the clerk, sheriff, treasurer and every other elected county row office. Read by src/core2/elections-calendar.ts.
